metaTitle: Custom Straight Fit Dress Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom straight fit dress shirts with your logo. Bulk pricing, quick turnaround, and free setup at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Straight fit dress shirts offer a classic, timeless silhouette that works well for a wide range of body types without being too slim or too loose. This cut provides a professional appearance that stays tucked in neatly throughout the day, making it a practical choice for uniform programs, trade shows, or corporate events. Whether you choose sustainable options like the Elemental Coffee Shirts or performance fabrics like the Port Authority Dimension Knit, straight fit ensures comfort and a polished look for your team.
heroAltText: Custom straight fit dress shirts in classic white and blue, featuring embroidered logos on the chest
